title: Exponential sums, decoupling and the circle method, Part II: geometric arcs and mapping-space cohomology
summary: This continuation constructs the geometric circle method for polynomial maps to smooth affine hypersurfaces, with rank-Hankel arc strata, compact-support Fourier complexes, signed configuration-space first pages and monodromy parity. It separates independent dimension, polynomial-counting and prime-choice prefixes from the parent arithmetic estimates. Conservative comparison and irreducibility ranges are distinguished from unproved sharper targets. Explicit infinity-germ obstructions and controlled collars delimit a conditional, rather than unconditional, mapping-space degeneration argument.
readme: See research/blueprint/readmes/ExponentialSumsAndCircleMethodPartII.md for conventions, every target, proof plan, API, discriminating checks, sources and unresolved gates. GCM.0–2 are independent prefixes; the parent field records lineage, and only the explicit stage edges describe execution order.

stages.title: Affine dimension and degree geometry
stages.description: Export componentwise codimension bounds, the affine intersection inequality, constructible fibre-dimension strata, and the finite-projection/degree contract needed by polynomial counting. This is an independent geometry prefix. Its only external mathematical input is scheme/commutative-algebra foundations; it has no arithmetic circle-method, configuration or mapping-space input.

stages.title: Polynomial boxes over a function field
stages.description: For V in affine N-space over F_q(T), bound polynomial points of strict height less than q^h by C(degree V,N) q^(h dim V), uniformly in q and coefficients. Treat empty and zero-dimensional V and nonpositive h explicitly. The BV15 projection and height-uniformity proof audit is a recorded gap. This independent prefix exports polynomialbox to ES.0 and to ES.5 separately.

stages.title: Admissible coefficient and residue primes
stages.description: Choose arbitrarily large coefficient primes of order two modulo a fixed odd characteristic. For a fixed coefficient prime choose arbitrarily large good residue characteristics in which it is a nonsquare and has even order, avoiding a prescribed finite bad set. Use the pinned Dirichlet and reciprocity theorems; no late geometric or arithmetic estimates enter.

stages.title: Polynomial maps and compact-support Fourier transform
stages.description: Represent fixed-leading-vector polynomial maps as a coefficient scheme, obtain the component dimension lower bound, prove smoothness and geometric irreducibility of the projective closure, and construct the residue phase and its Artin–Schreier compact-support transform. Identify the mapping-scheme cohomology by Fourier orthogonality, with coefficient extension, shift and twist fixed.

stages.title: Hankel rank arcs and rational approximation
stages.description: Define the saturated rank-Hankel filtration, prove closedness, nesting and the ceiling threshold at odd kd, and establish existence and uniqueness of reduced Padé data on exact strata. Construct the good-arc chart and its regular inverse and prove the dimension bound.

stages.title: Major-arc complexes and signed configuration descent
stages.description: Cancel bad arcs and repeated denominators, divide polynomials by a monic denominator, compute the affine-fibre shift, and factor the reduced phase by CRT. Identify the one-root complex with trace-reduced hypersurface cohomology and descend along the ordered-root torsor. Prove concentration in degree n−1 and the exact signed, twisted stratum formula for 0≤m≤d.

stages.title: Universal pairs and monodromy parity
stages.description: Construct the universal smooth polynomial/nonzero boundary-vector parameter space and its lisse middle cohomology extension. Prove the relevant fundamental-group surjections and specialize the companion universal-monodromy theorem to an element with eigenvalues −1, retaining the two cubic exceptions. Compute relative stratum cohomology for m≤d.

stages.title: Finite arc filtration and the first page
stages.description: Adapt the existing Mathlib spectral-object carrier to a finite localization filtration, including its abutment and functoriality. Construct absolute and relative major-arc spectral sequences, with differential degree (r,1−r). Derive odd-page vanishing from relative monodromy and give the normalized first page including every shift, Tate twist and symmetric-group sign.

stages.title: Geometric Weyl differencing
stages.description: Define k-indexed differencing loci and extended cohomological degree. Use coefficient-field conjugation, Künneth, finite-type fibre-dimension strata and detection at all closed points to prove the geometric Weyl inequality. Retain k as data when the actual polynomial degree drops, and retain minus infinity for acyclic complexes.

stages.title: Minor arcs with a controlled remainder
stages.description: Import the parent ES.0–1 polarization, shrinking and all-extension polynomial count. Deduce differencing-dimension and stalk bounds, cover the minor arcs through ceil(kd/2)−1, and retain the remainder in division by k−1. Prove conservative vanishing above 2dn+4(k−1)−4 floor(d/(k−1))(n/2^k−k+1). Keep the printed +4 bound as an open target.

stages.title: Comparison, spreading and irreducible mapping schemes
stages.description: Compare the normalized major-arc complex with mapping cohomology in the conservative strict range. Spread the entire pair (f,x), choosing a coefficient prime and good closed fibre with a common lisse open. Compute first-page and abutment support, the automatic high-degree degeneration range, and irreducibility when tδ>k−1. Record the sharper printed range and unconditional E1 degeneration as distinct unproved targets.

stages.title: Infinity germs and the compact-open obstruction
stages.description: Define the prescribed pointwise infinity germ and its compact-open topology, and prove continuity of polynomial-map inclusion in that topology. Build a shrinking phase, a smooth Fermat reference and an escaping loop. Construct the end-winding homomorphism using uniform projective charts on compact families; prove it is onto Z and obstructs the proposed compact-open double-loop comparison.

stages.title: Controlled collars and the topology gate
stages.description: Define a fixed-radius weighted collar with normal coordinate divided by z^d uniformly close to one. Straighten on an inner disc without creating zeros and without claiming a strong deformation retract. Specialize the existing CW restriction-fibration interface to fixed-boundary extension spaces. State the missing global stronger-germ topology, algebraic inclusion continuity and double-loop equivalence as an explicit gate.

stages.title: Trace comparison and conditional degeneration
stages.description: Define the trace-pairing conjecture for a specified topology and continuous algebraic inclusion. Disprove its compact-open interpretation in the cubic forty-variable example. Assuming the stronger-topology comparison and the trace conjecture, import configuration/rational-loop dimension formulas to obtain the conditional E1-degeneration argument. Separate negative-degree dimension equality from the range where an actual abutment comparison is known.
